capabilities: Reorder sections and subsections by drag and drop in a collapsible heading tree
Rename, indent, change level, copy, add or delete sections from a context menu
Show designated note subsections in a separate side panel next to the text
Track per-section statuses and word counts in a notes index
Capture quick notes and insert links to sections via a shortcut
extras: The interface is currently in French only; an English translation is planned. Tested on desktop and Android, with iOS feedback welcome.
intentEvidence: Outline tree of the current note's headings (H1 to H6) in the sidebar, collapsible and in sync with the editor.
motivation: The author wanted to work on long documents like a notebook in one file, keeping the overview and full-text export that splitting into notes would lose.
problem: Long single-file documents are hard to navigate and restructure, but splitting them into many notes loses the ability to read or export the whole text at once.
summary: Sidebar outline of a note's headings that lets you reorder, rename and manage sections by drag and drop within one Markdown file.
